violations.message: RiskReport must link at least one evidence id.

input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic overnight telemetry pool reported a routine software validation finding for the ventricular tachycardia detection pathway. Full overnight telemetry log and a same-shift clinician review both confirm no ventricular tachycardia episode occurred; the classifier's threshold alarm behaved as specified. No patient-facing exposure occurred and the engineering finding was fully contained pre-release or resolved as a non-event.
